title: A shared diary of a child’s sleep
description: The adults log stretches of sleep and notes so they can hand each other an up-to-date history.

blocks.text: An adult can find it hard to remember and log every short stretch of a child’s sleep. Convenient entry and a reminder can help keep the history; praise for a forecast in a review does not prove that the next night can be predicted accurately.

quote.text: I used to try to keep notes of her naps and would forget. This app makes it easy with reminders of when naps should occur.  It accurately predicts nap time and length, bedtime and morning wakes!

blocks.text: Let them mark the start and the end quickly, correct a time and add a short note. Everyone sees one current entry and can tell who changed it.

Test the hand-off of care between the adults and what happens with an entry that was missed. A familiar backdrop can be an additional feature. The main result is a history everyone agrees on, not a sleep routine prescribed for the child.
